mapper.select: select id, bus_no, type_enum, status_enum, item_table, item_id, purpose_location_id, lot_number, unit_code, total_quantity, is_deleted from wkf_supply_request where bus_no = #{busNo} and type_enum = #{typeEnum} and is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, bus_no, type_enum, status_enum, category_enum, item_table, item_id, item_quantity, total_quantity, unit_code, lot_number, trace_no, price, total_price, profit_loss_price, purpose_location_id, purpose_type_enum, source_location_id, source_type_enum, supplier_id, practitioner_id, applicant_id, apply_time, approver_id, approval_time, reason, remake, start_time, end_time, occurrence_time, is_deleted, version, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE bus_no = #{busNo} AND type_enum = #{typeEnum} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT sr.item_table, sr.item_id, m.name, m.total_volume, m.manufacturer_text, m.purchase_unit_code, sr.item_quantity, sr.unit_code, sr.lot_number, sr.start_time, sr.end_time, sr.trace_no, sr.remake, sr.price, sr.total_price, sr.occurrence_time, tc.display AS purchase_unit_text FROM wkf_supply_request sr LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition m ON sr.item_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ter_concept tc ON tc.sort_order = m.purchase_unit_code AND tc.code_system_id = 900002 WHERE sr.bus_no = #{busNo} ORDER BY sr.id ASC
